subject: Commercial onboarding: PO minimums, card limits, marketplace option
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire@littonbio.com>, Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@littonbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Commercial onboarding: PO minimums, card limits, marketplace option

Hi Claire / Marcus —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to unblock procurement: 

Call highlights (short):
- Litton prefers PO-based onboarding for new vendors due to control & audit trail.
- AP currently enforces a $10,000 PO threshold for new suppliers; corporate card allowed only for ad-hoc purchases under $3,000.
- Marketplace purchases are acceptable in principle but only for vendors already onboarded to Litton’s approved marketplace list.
- Litton needs SOC2 or equivalent security evidence before any production traffic.

What we can provide right away (attachments included):
- vendor-setup-checklist.csv — required fields AP will need (W-9, remit address, tax ID, payment terms).
- redwood-sow-template.pdf — example SOW & standard commercial terms to speed procurement review.
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf — short summary and point of contact for full report.

Options for next steps (pick one):
1) PO path (preferred by Litton):
   - We can accept PO. To meet the $10k new-vendor threshold, we can offer a time-limited pilot credit to cover initial usage (details below) so AP sees an initial invoice above threshold.
   - Deliverables: completed vendor-setup checklist, signed SOW (if needed), and W-9.
2) Marketplace route:
   - If Litton can buy via an approved marketplace (e.g., AWS Marketplace), purchase can go on card or marketplace billing, but Redwood needs to be listed and there’s typically a 4–6 week onboarding cadence.
   - Marketplace purchase reduces vendor paperwork for Litton but requires marketplace listing acceptance.

Suggested concrete next steps:
- Claire: confirm which procurement route you want to pursue (PO vs marketplace).
- Claire / Marcus: share AP contact for vendor setup (name + email).
- Marissa (cc’d) will assemble/redact the onboarding pack.
- Ben (cc’d) will prepare a one-page invoice/credit proposal to bridge the PO minimum if needed.

If helpful I can schedule a 30-minute liquor-call with your AP team to walk through the checklist. Proposed times: Mon 12/21 10–11am PT or Tue 12/22 1–2pm PT.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: vendor-setup-checklist.csv, redwood-sow-template.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
From: Claire Jensen <claire@littonbio.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@littonbio.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T12:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commercial onboarding: PO minimums, card limits, marketplace option

Thanks, Hannah — really useful summary. A few clarifications from AP/procurement side at Litton: 

- Confirmed: new vendor PO minimum is $10,000. That’s the threshold our approval workflow requires.
- Corporate card spend is tightly limited to < $3k per vendor, used for one-off SaaS renewals only.
- Marketplace purchases are allowed only if the vendor is pre-approved and listed on our procurement marketplace; very few new vendors get that fast-tracked.
- Security: we require a SOC2 or ISO27001 report (can be an attestation or a link to a hosted report) before we move to production.

I’ve attached our supplier intake guidelines for reference (litton-supplier-guidelines.pdf).

Procurement contact: Daniel Park — Senior AP Ops (daniel.park@littonbio.com). He’ll own vendor setup.

Given the $10k floor, we’re open to a PO for a pilot if Redwood can either (a) accept a smaller initial PO plus an invoice plan that meets audit requirements, or (b) provide an invoice/credit construct to make the initial transaction meet the threshold.

I’ll loop Daniel into the thread unless you want us to wait until we confirm paperwork.

Cheers,
Claire
Claire Jensen
Head of Product Operations | Litton Bio
claire@littonbio.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire@littonbio.com>, Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@littonbio.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@littonbio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T15:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commercial onboarding: PO minimums, card limits, marketplace option

Thanks Claire — welcome Daniel.

Quick responses and what we’ll do on our side: 
- SOC2: we’ve attached redwood-soc2-summary.pdf. We can provide a limited-access link to the full report and an NDA if your security team requires it.
- PO path: Marissa will prepare the vendor onboarding packet (completed W-9, remit address, our preferred invoice cadence). Ben will draft a short invoice + credit plan that bridges the $10k threshold (proposed: Redwood invoices $10k and applies a one-time pilot credit equal to the unused portion; we’ll clearly document the credit for Litton’s audit).
- Marketplace: we’re exploring faster marketplace listing options but realistically that takes 4–6 weeks (registry, procurement vetting, tax setup). If you need immediate access, PO path is faster.

Action items we’ll take in the next 48 hours:
- Marissa: share completed vendor packet template for Daniel to review (target: 12/21).
- Ben: share draft invoice/credit construct (target: EOD 12/20).
- Hannah: set up 30-minute vendor onboarding call with Daniel and AP — proposed Tue 12/22 1pm PT. Please confirm.

If Daniel confirms he needs any alternative docs (e.g., supplier attestations, insurance certs), tell us and we’ll include them.

—
Hannah
From: Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@littonbio.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-12-20T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Commercial onboarding: PO minimums, card limits, marketplace option

Thanks all — Daniel and I are good to meet. Daniel, can you take Marissa’s vendor packet when it’s ready and confirm if Litton needs additional attestations?

My availability for the 30-min call: Wed 12/23 9–10am PT or Thu 12/24 11–11:30am PT. Either works for me if Daniel can join.

Also, Claire asked I mention: if Redwood has a partner/reseller option (invoice from a partner) that can help with our procurement timeline, that might be a viable short-term route. Any partners we should highlight?

Looking forward to finalizing.

Marcus Reed
Sr. Technical Program Manager | Litton Bio
marcus.reed@littonbio.com
